reservoir_ep20_001.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_001.text: The days from One Thousand Three Hundred Sixteen through Nineteen were actual modest preparation and ordinary rest. Yue performed only the familiar safe sets Deng had agreed to observe, with full releases and the old input ceiling. She added no night practice to make the registered morning look better. Jing kept the accepted blank and prepared sleeves in custody. Mei retained the independent stop decision. When Twenty arrived, the room would measure the present body, not total the effort Yue had spent hoping to bring a respectable quantity into it.

reservoir_ep20_002.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_002.text: On One Thousand Three Hundred Twenty, the ordinary starting review found Yue recovered for the bounded changed-temperature trial. Her shoulder remained within its established range, with no headache or new tissue concern. Jing read the actual cool room condition and compared the accepted blank independently. The registered warm change would stay inside its mild ordinary targets. Deng stood by the low marker rather than answer the examiner's questions. Mei asked Yue to name the full stop before any input began. The first qualifying morning had actually arrived, with no result yet available.

reservoir_ep20_003.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_003.text: The usable starting inventory after the preceding night's sleep and ordinary morning activity measured seventy-three and one eighth. The registered quarter-unit total sampling cost was divided into two eighth-unit withdrawals, one before the task and one after the changed response. Jing took the first eighth, leaving seventy-three usable. The sample and its method entered the current comparison. Yue could not retain that withdrawn eighth because the result mattered to her. The task would consume its own actual half-unit input before the final sample and usable threshold were read.

reservoir_ep20_004.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_004.text: The room changed from its recorded cool condition toward the registered warm target while Yue performed the familiar low four-breath application. No ordinary breath exceeded an eighth unit, and the actual total input was half a unit. The already measured useful application remained a quarter unit. Yue noticed warmth at her neck and the old urge to watch the comparison edge too closely. She kept the ordinary room in attention and completed the agreed stop. The half-unit task left seventy-two and a half usable before the last actual sample.

reservoir_exam_trial_a.speaker: narrator
reservoir_exam_trial_a.text: Under the recorded warm condition and its return toward the registered cool comparison, the reservoir retained balance within the local criterion. Yue released fully at the actual ordinary signal rather than a remembered rhythm. Jing withdrew the second eighth-unit sample. The final actually usable inventory was seventy-two and three eighths, after the full quarter-unit sampling total, half-unit task, actual sleep and morning activity. The independently compared compatible portion was ninety-two and one quarter percent. No extra drift had been hidden or rounded away. The changed-temperature trial met its preregistered conditions.

reservoir_ep20_006.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_006.text: Mei signed the completed changed-temperature record and left the certificate line blank. This was one qualifying condition on one actual recovered morning. The next-day clinical and current-control check still belonged to One Thousand Three Hundred Twenty-one, and the other two distinct conditions had not occurred. Yue felt relief so strong she wanted to laugh, then waited until the sample sleeve was safely back with Jing. The clean result did not raise her stage yet. It gave the later decision one real piece of evidence she could stand beside without making it larger.

reservoir_ep20_007.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_007.text: Deng asked Yue to describe what had differed from the original warm failure. She said she had noticed the room before searching its trace for approval. The warmth still felt unpleasant, and wanting a favorable result had not disappeared. The full stop had remained available within that actual feeling. Deng accepted the account as teaching evidence beside Mei's independent comparison. Neither replaced the other. Yue stood from the low mat only after grounding was settled, keeping her shoulder within the familiar ordinary range and claiming no new physical ability from the result.

reservoir_ep20_008.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_008.text: Jing recorded the inventory in order: seventy-three and an eighth starting, an eighth sampled, half a unit used in the familiar task, another eighth sampled, seventy-two and three eighths remaining. The prepared recovery replacement material used by this trial had its actual custody source; the original failed temperature consumption stayed in its earlier record. Nothing was restored merely because the recovered trial had passed. Yue asked to see the final line once, then let Jing put the sleeve away. The quantity could remain accurate without being watched for the rest of the day.

reservoir_ep20_009.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_009.text: At lunch Tian asked whether the ducks had finally approved the handwriting. Yue said one warm room had accepted her present balance, and tomorrow still had a real appointment. He offered a drawing of the river onion wearing an ordinary coat. She laughed and accepted the private scrap as offered. The kitchen meal remained its actual daily arrangement. Nobody charged a celebration to the formal clinical line or promoted her to stage eight over beans. Her friends could be pleased about one completed trial while letting its required next morning remain unfinished.

reservoir_ep20_010.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_010.text: Fu joined the table after her ordinary shift and asked whether Yue wanted to discuss the trace or enjoy lunch. Yue chose lunch first. The option felt almost extravagant after months of numbers. Fu described her brother's song acquiring a new audience condition: nobody could request an encore before he ate. Yue approved the rule and asked whether the actual listeners had agreed. They had, mostly because they also wanted food. The ordinary story made the room less solemn without diminishing the trial. A useful first result belonged among people's days rather than above them.

reservoir_ep20_011.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_011.text: That afternoon Yue performed no extra input to preserve or enlarge the trial result. The follow-up needed the actual next morning after ordinary recovery, not a private evening attempt hidden from its source. Deng confirmed the rest instruction, and Yue used the short comfortable walk permitted by her present condition. Her shoulder had no new pain. The final trial quantity was seventy-two and three eighths at its measured time. Tomorrow's actual starting reserve would be compared again after sleep and morning activity, with a new sample cost deducted rather than assume yesterday's number could never change.

reservoir_ep20_012.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_012.text: On One Thousand Three Hundred Twenty-one, the ordinary clinician examined the actual post-trial tissue condition, shoulder range, headache report and current recovery. No new injury or headache was found, and the old shoulder restrictions remained. Jing's accepted blank settled before the independent next-day comparison. After actual sleep and ordinary morning activity, seventy-two and three eighths measured usable before sampling. The quarter-unit next-day withdrawal left seventy-two and one eighth. Compatibility remained ninety-two and one quarter percent. The actual sample was gone, and the present quantity still met the local seventy-two condition.

reservoir_exam_next_a.speaker: narrator
reservoir_exam_next_a.text: Mei observed familiar zero-draw grounding and an ordinary stop without adding another application task to the next-day appointment. The recovered balance remained stable under that present check, and the clinician's actual tissue findings were accepted beside the comparison. Four coppers paid the delivered appointment from the twelve reserved for formal next-day clinical checks, leaving eight for the later two. The first trial and its actual next morning were now complete. Yue remained stage seven because movement, changed sleep and their next-day checks still lay ahead.

reservoir_ep20_014.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_014.text: The next-day record did not rewrite the trial's seventy-two and three eighths into a larger amount. Its own new sample had left seventy-two and one eighth actually usable today. Both dated results stayed visible, with separate costs and conditions. Yue could see why the follow-up mattered: the body had carried a recovered night after the changed response without hiding depletion in a remembered peak. Mei accepted the condition and closed only that part of the series. The local certificate would wait until all three qualifying pairs were actually delivered.

reservoir_ep20_015.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_015.text: At supper the pump candidate congratulated her on a real first pair and asked whether the relief felt complete. It did not. She still worried about the movement lag and the interrupted-sleep pause. He said his own good results had also created more specific worries rather than eliminated them. Their shared ordinary experience made the feeling less lonely. Yue could celebrate the actual warm response and its next morning while still want more evidence. She would not need to call the remaining fear irrational in order to return to safe practice.

reservoir_ep20_016.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_016.text: Days Twenty-two through Twenty-four were actual recovered ordinary rest and modest qualified practice. Deng retained the old input ceiling and full grounding between finite familiar sets. Recorded input supplied the later reserve's real source without being equated to usable storage. Yue's current quantity could change through application, sampling, discharge, work and sleep. The independent movement starting state would be measured anew on Thirty-four. She did not save an imaginary bank of units by adding every gross intake to the next-day number and omitting the ordinary losses in between.

reservoir_ep20_017.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_017.text: Jing showed the new clerk how the two eighth-unit trial samples differed from the single quarter-unit next-day sample in the dated record. The total sampling cost was explicit on each day, and no sleeve's reliable condition made withdrawn qi remain usable inside Yue. The clerk asked whether so much exactness spoiled celebration. Yue said it made the celebration easier to carry afterward. She knew what the first completed pair had actually supported. The clerk nodded and drew no fish beside its numbers, leaving his art for an ordinary scrap at lunch.

reservoir_ep20_018.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_018.text: On Twenty-five Fu invited Yue to a short garden song gathering. The brother announced he would eat before any encore, keeping his new audience condition. The listeners complied because the beans were warm. Yue enjoyed the whole song and gave no correction until he asked about the middle rhythm afterward. Their months of ordinary promises had made the conversation easier. She had one qualifying pair behind her and friends still capable of asking her to listen rather than perform a better result. The gathering ended while her current body remained comfortable.

reservoir_ep20_019.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_019.text: On Twenty-six Deng practiced the familiar low turn after full grounding, with no new load or faster movement. Yue could feel the original movement failure's memory and kept the ordinary mechanics relaxed before beginning intake. The modest safe set ended at the actual stop. Its teaching response was useful; it did not certify the upcoming registered movement condition. Deng wanted the later independent morning to observe a recovered body, not one exhausted by trying to repeat the future trial every afternoon. Yue accepted the finite lesson and left on time.

reservoir_ep20_020.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_020.text: Qiu checked the registered movement route's ordinary physical condition on Twenty-seven. The level dry turn and low markers remained within the task already tested. No overhead catch, wider reach or heavier load had been added. A broken ordinary cord at the edge was repaired from the pavilion's actual maintenance arrangement before the room was accepted. Yue could see how reliable surroundings supported an honest test. They would not guarantee the reservoir's response, but the examiner would not ask her to protect everyone from an uncounted site flaw while measuring control.

reservoir_ep20_021.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_021.text: On Twenty-eight, the daughter from the water households greeted Yue at the ordinary public desk. She shared only present public news and no private diary. Yue did not claim the old project access had expanded because a qualifying trial went well. A later certificate could open particular qualified opportunities under new terms, not grant every source she had ever wanted. They spoke about the current garden bird and parted. The encounter reminded Yue that useful bodily progress belonged to a life already full of other people's consent, boundaries and ordinary authority.

reservoir_ep20_022.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_022.text: Twenty-nine passed with modest practice, actual rest and the independent room's preparation. Jing kept the movement blank and samples distinct from the earlier temperature sleeves. Yue asked whether a familiar low load still needed its current condition checked. It did, and its ordinary owner source confirmed it was sound. The registered task's range stayed the same. The body could fail an ordinary movement condition even when every object was reliable. That possibility was what the test would examine, with a real stop available before disappointment became a larger injury.

reservoir_ep20_023.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_023.text: On One Thousand Three Hundred Thirty, Yue sent an actual ordinary family letter. The private dispatch cost one copper from completed personal wages, separate from the course's formal checks. She reported the completed temperature trial and its real next morning, with movement and changed sleep still ahead. She included the coat-wearing river onion and Fu's brother's meal-before-encore rule. The letter promised no certificate date and no restored years. Her mother could hear honest progress without being asked to live the remaining days as an anxious audience awaiting a triumphant final line.

reservoir_ep20_024.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_024.text: Tian wanted to know whether the river onion had finally become respectable. Yue said it had survived a warm room and then requested beans. Jing declared that a sensible ordinary ambition. Their lunch laughter was brief because Tian had an actual shift to resume. He left the offered drawing with Yue and returned to the date board. Friendship could have a finite interval without feeling less real. The actual next clinical payment remained reserved in its separate line, while the ordinary letter had used a real personal copper that would not be spent again.

reservoir_ep20_025.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_025.text: On Thirty-one Deng retained a short familiar release lesson and no harder practice. Yue reported comfortable current recovery and the wish to hurry into the next qualifying morning. He let her name the wish, then asked for the full stop before another set. She ended the lesson after the agreed finite work. The temperature pair's good result did not clear a different task automatically. Movement would need its own changed condition, actual costs, independent compatible portion and next morning. The local sequence had been stated before failure and would remain the same before another possible success.

reservoir_ep20_026.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_026.text: Jing's father invited her to taste the first beans from the newer row on Thirty-two. Their flavor differed from the older crop, and he blamed the soil before Jing asked about the cooking. He laughed and agreed to compare the ordinary preparation first. Yue ate as a guest, with no sample sleeve at the table. The practical exchange reminded her that careful comparisons could remain curious rather than grim. She wanted to bring that ordinary attention to the movement room, where a result could be useful even if it refused to flatter months of work.

reservoir_ep20_027.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_027.text: On Thirty-three the ordinary starting preparation confirmed tomorrow's bounded movement task could remain scheduled if Yue woke recovered. Its next-day clinical appointment was still booked for Thirty-five from the finite formal-check line. She packed no travel bag, accepted no extra ordinary shift and performed no private late intake. The familiar circuit settled at its earned stage. The next morning's actually usable quantity would include the sleep and ordinary activity that occurred, not the best number she could recall from the past fortnight. She laid out the practice clothes and slept.

reservoir_ep20_028.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_028.text: One Thousand Three Hundred Thirty-four arrived with a sound ordinary route and a recovered starting review. Yue reported no headache or new shoulder pain, and the clinician retained the existing low-load range. Jing's independent blank settled within its accepted condition. The usable starting inventory after sleep and morning activity measured seventy-three and a quarter. The first eighth-unit sample left seventy-three and one eighth. A second eighth would follow the actual movement response, making the registered quarter-unit total sampling cost explicit before the final usable reading.

reservoir_ep20_029.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_029.text: Yue performed the familiar half-unit four-breath application within the old eighth-unit maximum on each ordinary breath. Its already rated useful output remained a quarter unit. The half-unit task left seventy-two and five eighths before the changed movement. She carried the permitted light load close to her waist through the level dry turn at ordinary speed, with no overhead shoulder catch or wider reach. The reservoir did not lag at the actual marker. She attended to the room, followed the agreed stop and grounded fully before handing the ordinary load to its appointed receiver.

reservoir_exam_trial_b.speaker: narrator
reservoir_exam_trial_b.text: Jing took the second eighth-unit sample after the actual changed movement and completed the independent comparison. Seventy-two and a half remained usable after the full quarter-unit sampling total, actual half-unit task, sleep and morning activity. The compatible portion measured ninety-two and a half percent. Balance had remained within the registered criterion through the ordinary turn and full stop, with no hidden drift or increased draw. The movement trial met its local preregistered conditions on this separate recovered date. Mei signed its completed record and left stage eight uncertified until the remaining checks occurred.

reservoir_ep20_031.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_031.text: After the movement stop, Yue remained at the low seat until Jing put the prepared sleeve into safe custody. She felt relief and ordinary tiredness, with no new shoulder pain. Deng asked about the original lag and she described its absence at the actual marked turn. The registered load and range had stayed familiar. A sound result under this condition did not make an overhead catch or a different carrying task safe. Mei accepted the current account beside the instrument comparison and reminded her that tomorrow remained a real required appointment.

reservoir_ep20_032.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_032.text: The movement inventory stayed explicit: seventy-three and a quarter starting, an eighth sampled, half a unit consumed by the familiar task, another eighth sampled, seventy-two and a half remaining. The two sample costs did not disappear because the trace was pleasing. Yue asked whether she could call the trial a pass in the family letter later. Mei said she could describe this actual completed condition and its next morning after delivery, while leaving the certificate open until changed sleep and follow-up. The honest wording would be good news large enough to tell.

reservoir_ep20_033.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_033.text: At lunch Tian presented a fish walking through an improbably narrow turn. Yue said the actual movement route had been level and broad enough for its permitted ordinary task. Tian refused to ruin the picture with realistic geometry. Jing said the picture could remain ridiculous as long as nobody copied it into the examination record. They laughed and left the paper beside the bean bowl. Yue's good morning had not acquired every surface in the kitchen. Her friends could welcome it through an absurd gift and then ask whether she wanted onions.

reservoir_ep20_034.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_034.text: Fu joined them and wanted to know whether the full stop had felt different. Yue chose to share the ordinary sensation of being able to hear the room before handing over the load. Fu said that sounded useful even when no instrument was watching. Yue agreed and kept the distinction between useful practice and the certificate's required evidence. A body could develop dependable control before the local board had completed its formal decision. The remaining sleep condition would still need to show that dependability under its own real interrupted night.

reservoir_ep20_035.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_035.text: That afternoon Yue followed the agreed ordinary recovery plan with no extra input or new application. A next-day comparison should not receive an unreported evening effort designed to preserve a favorable number. The current trial's seventy-two and a half belonged to its measured time. Tomorrow's usable starting quantity would be compared after actual sleep and morning activity, then its sample withdrawn. Deng retained the finite rest instruction. Yue visited the sound garden bench briefly and left while comfortable, rather than turn relief into another tiring tour of everyone who might congratulate her.

reservoir_ep20_036.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_036.text: On One Thousand Three Hundred Thirty-five, the clinician delivered the actual movement follow-up. Tissue condition and shoulder range remained unchanged, with no new headache or injury. The formal series' agreed care included the condition preparation and this next-day review; no second private bill appeared for the same delivered appointment. Jing's accepted blank settled before comparison. Seventy-two and a half measured usable after sleep and ordinary morning activity before the quarter-unit sample. That withdrawal left seventy-two and a quarter, with ninety-two and a half percent compatibility still observed independently.

reservoir_exam_next_b.speaker: narrator
reservoir_exam_next_b.text: Mei observed familiar zero-draw grounding and an ordinary stop during the actual current-control check. The recovered balance remained stable within that condition. Four coppers paid the delivered movement follow-up from the formal twelve-copper clinical line, bringing actual delivered formal payments to eight and leaving four for the changed-sleep next morning. The movement trial and its required follow-up were now complete on separate dates from temperature. Yue remained stage seven. The last registered condition and its actual next day still stood between this record and an independent balanced-reservoir certificate.

reservoir_ep20_038.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_038.text: Jing kept the next-day seventy-two and a quarter separate from the trial's seventy-two and a half. Its new quarter-unit sample was actually gone. She did not copy the larger prior number over the smaller present one because both still met the local minimum. The tissue and control findings had their own actual sources beside the current comparison. Yue could see why a certificate needed the paired dates rather than a handful of peaks. The body had lived through the night between them, and its reserve had paid for another piece of evidence.

reservoir_ep20_039.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_039.text: At the public desk Qiu received the accepted two-pair status from Mei and kept its wording precise. Two qualifying trials and two next-day checks were complete; the third changed condition remained pending. No stage-eight endorsement would be issued from that notice. Yue heard the description and felt both proud and impatient. Qiu offered ordinary tea, not a promise to expedite the missing morning. The current source could support a true report. A more pleasing title before its conditions were complete would give later receivers information they could not safely rely on.

reservoir_ep20_040.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_040.text: A public notice maker asked whether he could shorten the wording to 'balanced reservoir demonstrated.' Mei said that would omit the unfinished condition and misdescribe the present evidence. He had space for the full statement if he removed an unnecessary decorative border. Tian was appalled by the attack on borders until Yue pointed out which sentence the border had nearly cost. He agreed reluctantly. The notice maker chose the accurate current wording. An ordinary layout decision had real implications when people used a title to imagine what bodily tasks a candidate could perform.

reservoir_ep20_041.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_041.text: The correction did not prevent every rumor. A market visitor asked Yue that afternoon whether she was now stage eight and therefore could protect his carrier from a broken axle. She answered the first question accurately and the second separately. The independent certificate was unfinished, and neither its eventual result nor her current earned practice cleared shielding a vehicle. The carrier needed qualified ordinary repair and its own current safety check. The visitor went to its actual receiving desk. Yue had felt the temptation to let him think her almost-certified status meant more, and resisted it.

reservoir_ep20_042.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_042.text: Fu heard the rumor and asked whether Yue wanted to be angry about it for a few minutes. She did. They sat on the ordinary public bench and complained that a clean result seemed to generate abilities nobody had measured. Then Fu said she had once expected a new boot cord to make her brother punctual. Yue laughed and admitted people loved a useful improvement that solved adjacent annoyances for free. The laugh did not erase the problem. She would need to keep naming the actual scope, particularly after any future certificate made the rumor easier to believe.

reservoir_ep20_043.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_043.text: On Thirty-six, Deng supervised modest recovered familiar practice and no new load. Yue described the rumor's carrier shield request before grounding. He asked whether she had wanted to accept it because the man was frightened or because she liked how impressive the request made her feel. Both had been present. The admission embarrassed her and made the temptation easier to recognize. They performed one finite safe set with the old ceiling and full release. The lesson did not punish honesty by demanding a larger draw to prove she had learned a moral correction.

reservoir_ep20_044.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_044.text: At lunch the pump candidate described a similar request to stop a leaking wall through qi. His actual earned task did not include that application. He had sent the household to its qualified ordinary worker and still felt cowardly for an hour. Yue understood. They discussed how helpful people could learn to state a smaller actual ability before an emergency. The village would need different skills from different workers. Their useful reservoir practices would not make those workers redundant or return money already spent on safe ordinary methods.

reservoir_ep20_045.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_045.text: Jing showed Yue the remaining changed-sleep trial's accepted preparation stock on Thirty-seven. Its sample sleeves had been checked, the ordinary blank kept distinct and the actual discharge method recorded. The registered total sample cost would again be a quarter unit split into two eighths around the familiar task. The final actual usable quantity would include the changed night's condition and half-unit application. The next-day sample would have its own quarter-unit cost. There was no hidden reserve left uncounted merely because the last condition looked emotionally more difficult than the first two.

reservoir_ep20_046.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_046.text: Yue read that last condition and remembered how the original interrupted night had made her hurry. The eventual registered ordinary interruption would be bounded, with its duration and return to sleep recorded. She could withdraw if the actual starting condition was unsuitable, and the examiner could stop the task if control failed. Both possibilities remained real. She did not interpret two passed pairs as a guarantee that the third would complete. The improved quiet reserve could support preparation without forcing a tired body to preserve an already promised ending.

reservoir_ep20_047.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_047.text: Fu's brother asked whether he could perform a song outside the pavilion during the changed-sleep trial to supply an interruption. Qiu refused because the registered condition had its own ordinary method and actual observer. He accepted the answer after pretending deep artistic disappointment. Yue thanked him for asking before arranging the song. The refusal preserved the independent condition without rejecting the ordinary friendship. He proposed a later garden audience instead. The candidate could be surrounded by affection while the examination room retained its actual prepared sources rather than become a theater run by well-meaning friends.

reservoir_ep20_048.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_048.text: On Thirty-eight, the child brought his newly painted boat to the public garden instead of the wet bank. Its maker had completed the chosen ordinary wrist review and could resume comfortable light play within the current instructions, with heavier demands still separately limited. The parent supplied only the public update offered. Yue praised the bean bird as requested and asked whether the child wanted to launch the boat when the sound supervised route was available. He preferred to show Jing's father first. The object had a real owner whose present plan need not serve the adults' idea of recovery.

reservoir_ep20_049.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_049.text: Jing's father declared the bird insufficiently beanlike and was asked to eat his beans before commenting on art. He obeyed with exaggerated sorrow. Yue laughed at the ordinary argument and found her attention less trapped by the coming sleep condition for a while. A pleasant afternoon did not prepay the body's response. It let her rest among people who continued their own lives. Later she returned to the course kitchen and ate the actual meal, keeping the remaining formal check money in its source rather than convert it into a celebration gift.

reservoir_ep20_050.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_050.text: The ordinary course household began preparing its final meal-attendance reconciliation for the finite end. Yue's actual family absence credits had already returned to the teaching source, with no private road subsidy hidden in them. Current meals remained delivered while she was present. The held bed had been a real reserved space. Yue would pay ordinary food and bed personally after Three Hundred Fifty-nine until departure, using completed wages and retained recovery allowance. The later road fare and fifteen actual travel days would also have a separate private source. A local certificate would not extend free lodging by implication.

reservoir_ep20_051.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_051.text: Qiu confirmed that later basin offers would be read only after the independent certificate decision, without making the examination's fee or current care depend on accepting a post. Yue could choose a finite public observer role, a separately funded maintenance service or departure under their eventual actual terms. The owners would ratify record scope, duty dates and pay. No tools or apparatus would become hers simply because she had practiced near them. Hearing that arrangement helped her face the last condition without imagining a failed result would make her completed wages belong to the institution instead.

reservoir_ep20_052.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_052.text: On Thirty-nine Deng retained a short familiar lesson and a real full stop. Yue felt recovered and wanted more practice, but he ended at the agreed finite boundary. The next registered changed-sleep night was still more than a week away. More input now was not automatically better preparation than ordinary recovery and attention to the actual pause. She accepted the end and went to the public bridge. The reed tapped unevenly again, and she heard it without counting the taps into a hidden method that might guarantee the coming result.

reservoir_ep20_053.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_053.text: At the bridge she met the mother from the water households and received only the public ordinary news offered. The old project had closed under its selected scope. Yue did not turn two passed qualifying pairs into a right to private records or claim a new maintenance authority. She could be a person greeting another person by water. They discussed the garden's last beans and parted before either had an actual appointment to miss. The ordinary exchange helped keep the reservoir's future purpose concrete without expanding its certificate into a claim over everybody she had once helped.

reservoir_ep20_054.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_054.text: That evening Yue reread the unsent family letter drafts. The possible success version now had two actual qualifying pairs described, with the last condition still open. The possible failure version remained equally worth sending if that condition stopped. She included the rumor about shielding a carrier and her accurate refusal. Her mother would understand a daughter whose useful abilities had limits. The old lost years remained irreversible. Yue wanted advancement to make her ordinary life more dependable, rather than replace that life with stories she could not uphold beside an actual frightened receiver.

reservoir_ep20_055.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_055.text: Jing came to ask whether Yue wanted ordinary company or quiet before bed. She chose quiet and thanked her. Jing accepted the answer without making solitude a sign of discouragement. The friendship had grown through many particular requests actually heard. Yue had once treated every offered visit as something she must welcome to prove gratitude. Now she could rest when rest was the useful thing. The changed-sleep trial would eventually test a body capable of wanting both company and silence, which made protecting tonight's actual sleep less grand and more practical.

reservoir_ep20_056.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_056.text: At dawn on One Thousand Three Hundred Forty, the room preparation remained on schedule for the last condition. Yue had no ordinary wage duty left and no water-project property to hand over. The temperature and movement pairs stayed complete in their dated records, with sampling costs visible. Her stage remained seven. Changed sleep and its next morning still required actual dates and independent evidence. She ate breakfast before modest practice, ready to let that condition be different rather than merely the expected ending of the first two.

reservoir_ep20_057.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_057.text: A private reply from the mother arrived that morning through the ordinary courier. It described the low shelf still useful, the plum rent still unpaid and Qiu Fang's current visits still chosen from the household's own budget. The mother's shortened work periods and shoulder limits remained. She was pleased about the first completed qualifying pair reported in the earlier letter and asked whether Yue had remembered to eat before celebrating. She had not received the later movement result yet. The household's actual information had a date, rather than magically keeping pace with the pavilion.

reservoir_ep20_058.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_058.text: Yue laughed at the food question and read the reply again. The woman also wanted to know whether the river onion ever acquired a mouth. Its original startled silence had apparently become a household joke. Yue drew one version with a tiny mouth and disliked it immediately. She kept the original. Her mother's pleasure in a ridiculous picture survived beside irreversible old costs and ordinary work limits. The letter did not make those costs smaller, and Yue did not need to make the joke solemn in order to remember them.

reservoir_ep20_059.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_059.text: Fu joined her for the ordinary breakfast and heard only the parts Yue wished to share. She said the mother sounded particular, which Yue preferred to any description of her as merely courageous. The woman had opinions about shelves, fruit rent, supper and ugly drawings. The daughter would send the final actual examination news when its record was complete, without asking another household to become the audience for every hour of anticipation. Fu passed the beans and let the conversation move to the song, whose singer now required breakfast before rehearsal as well as supper before encores.

reservoir_ep20_060.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_060.text: Deng's modest lesson later that morning began with full grounding and a familiar safe set. Yue's attention moved toward the mother reply during the pause, and she stopped early rather than pretend she had heard his actual cue. They discussed the distraction before continuing one smaller set. An affectionate letter could alter attention as readily as fear. The later changed-sleep condition would meet a body carrying ordinary feelings, not one whose family had been removed from its mind to make a cleaner examination. The lesson ended while her present condition remained comfortable.

reservoir_ep20_061.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_061.text: Jing asked whether Yue wanted the current preparation schedule beside the mother letter or kept at the public desk. She preferred the desk. The family page could remain private news rather than another practice chart. Jing accepted that ordinary distinction and returned to her actual instrument work. Reliable custody would make the last comparison possible, while the owner of a letter could decide where it rested. Yue put the reply beside the plum-tree drawing and felt the room become more hers without acquiring any object from the shared sample shelf.

reservoir_ep20_062.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_062.text: At lunch the new clerk asked how soon a current trial result should be copied onto the ordinary public board. Yue said the actual accepted source and scope had to arrive first. He showed the precisely worded two-pair notice with its uncompleted condition visible. Tian had moved the decorative border below the text and declared the resulting layout artistically tolerable. Yue thanked both for the actual correction. Public readers could now see real progress without receiving a title that promised untested bodily tasks or omitted the last ordinary night.

reservoir_ep20_063.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_063.text: The evening was quiet enough that Yue wanted to fill it with another useful set. She recognized the impulse and kept the agreed rest. The final condition would include actual interruption, return to sleep and a fresh starting comparison. None could be improved by exhausting the preparation week in advance. She took the short sound garden walk, returned before fatigue and ate the actual supper. Friends discussed ordinary beans without requiring a report. The approaching examination was large in her mind and still only one part of the day.

reservoir_ep20_064.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep20_064.text: Before sleep Yue checked the registered interruption date once and left the paper at the low table. Two trials and two next mornings were complete, with real samples deducted. Changed sleep remained pending. The fixed independent fee and final clinical appointment would support an honest decision regardless of its result. She lowered the lamp and let tonight's recovery happen.
